engine: PostgreSQL 16 Alpine in a local Docker fixture
case: Server-inferred query parameter types for domain-over-enum comparisons
added_coverage: A direct domain comparison remains explicitly refused with SQLSTATE 42883.
Casting the domain column to its base enum permits PostgreSQL to infer text parameters for <, <=, > and >= in addition to the existing =, <>, and BETWEEN cases.
For every ordering operator, pg_typeof($1)::text is the qualified base enum, pg_typeof(status)::text is the domain, and result values include SQL NULL propagation.
independent_oracle: PostgreSQL 16 pg_typeof() results and exact per-row comparison truth values for enum-backed domain rows including SQL NULL.
